Definition: something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Nehushtan = "a thing of brass"; 1) name by which the brazen serpent made by Moses in the wilderness was worshipped in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah before he destroyed it
